Name: Swift Scythe Harvest 1.6 - No Dependencies (Standalone)
Author: 66rayyan99
Description:
[b]Overview[/b]
Tired of harvesting your crops one by one by hand? [b]Swift Scythe Harvest[/b] is the ultimate quality-of-life improvement for your farm! This mod allows you to harvest [b]every type of crop[/b] using any [b]Scythe[/b] or [b]Sword[/b]. It is built from the ground up to be lightweight, fast, and fully compatible with the [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] update.
[b]Key Features[/b]
[list]
[*][b]🚀 1.6 Optimized:[/b] Native performance for the 1.6 update. No lag, no stuttering—just smooth harvesting.[/*]
[*][b]📦 Zero Dependencies:[/b] Unlike other mods, this is a [b]standalone[/b] tool. You don't need [i]Content Patcher[/i] or any other framework mods to make it work. Just SMAPI and you're good to go![/*]
[*][b]⚔️ Multi-Tool Support:[/b] Works with the Basic Scythe, Golden Scythe, Iridium Scythe, and all Swords.[/*]
[*][b]✨ Visual Polish:[/b] Includes custom [b]Leaf Particles[/b] and sound effects to make every swing feel satisfying.[/*]
[*][b]🏃 Harvest While Running:[/b] No more stopping to pick up items. Keep your momentum and clear your fields in seconds.[/*]
[/list][b]Installation[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [b]SMAPI[/b].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]SwiftScytheHarvest[/code]folder into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Run the game and start swinging![/*]
[/list][b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with [b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b].[/*]
[*]Works perfectly with modded crops (from mods like [i]Stardew Valley Expanded[/i] or [i]Ridgeside Village[/i]).[/*]
[*]Safe to add or remove mid-save.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Author's Note:[/b] This mod was designed to be as simple and "vanilla-friendly" as possible. No complicated menus or settings—it just works!

Manifest.Description: A professional scythe harvest mod that supports crops, forageables, and custom scythes with full vanilla effects.
